name: Samaneh Heshmatzadeh
intro: I build web applications with React, Next.js, Django, and PostgreSQL—from responsive interfaces to APIs and database workflows. I focus on clear interfaces, maintainable code, and reliable experiences for the people using them.
photoNote: A space for the person behind the pixels.
projectIntro: A selection of team contributions and full-stack projects. Explore each project to learn more.

restaurant.title: Restaurant Insights
restaurant.description: A multilingual platform for restaurant management and analytics, with restaurant and branch onboarding.
restaurant.details: Built with Next.js, Supabase, Drizzle, and oRPC. The public code includes restaurant and branch setup, business-hours forms, menu data models, and shared authentication and onboarding checks.

remarcable.title: Remarcable Product Search
remarcable.description: A responsive product catalogue with live search, category filters, and multi-tag filtering.
remarcable.details: A Django API and Next.js frontend with filters synchronized to the URL, sortable results, mobile product cards, and loading and error states. Django QuerySets optimize related data; production uses PostgreSQL with Heroku and Vercel deployments.

sips.title: Sips Cafe
sips.description: A bubble tea ordering platform with menu browsing, payments, and administration tools.
sips.details: A BCIT team project using C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, and Azure SQL. Features include PayPal payments, user and order management, authentication and authorization, email verification, and Google reCAPTCHA.
sips.problem: Bring bubble tea ordering, payments, and day-to-day administration into one application.
sips.decision: Used ASP.NET Identity for authentication and authorization, with email verification and reCAPTCHA to support account security.
sips.contribution: Developed full-stack functionality with C#, ASP.NET Core, and Azure SQL. My work included authentication and authorization with ASP.NET Identity, email verification, reCAPTCHA, REST APIs, and relational database structures.
sips.outcome: The team built an ordering platform connecting menu browsing, PayPal checkout, and administration. The project provided hands-on experience integrating identity, APIs, and a relational database.

movie.title: Movie Mania
movie.description: Explore movies from TMDB and organize favorites and a personal watchlist.
movie.details: Built with React and Redux for shared state, Axios for TMDB requests, and React Router for navigation. The project supports adding and removing movies from favorites and watchlists.

deck.title: Deck Master
deck.description: An online store with product browsing, order handling, and PayPal payments.
deck.details: A C# MVC application backed by SQL. The project combines storefront pages, user and role administration, transaction views, and a PayPal checkout flow.

billing.title: Express Billing
billing.description: A billing application with authenticated access and MongoDB-backed billing records.
billing.details: Built with Node.js and Express, using Passport for authentication and MongoDB for storing billing information. The application supports publishing and managing customer bills.

dinemetric.title: Dinemetric
dinemetric.description: An AI-powered restaurant platform with menu recommendations and insights to support daily operations.
dinemetric.problem: Help restaurant teams turn operational data into actionable insights and AI-powered menu recommendations.
dinemetric.decision: Uses a typed oRPC client with request batching to connect the Next.js interface to application services.
dinemetric.details: Team contribution to an AI-powered restaurant management and analytics application that provides menu recommendations. The live link opens the public sign-in screen shown above.
dinemetric.contribution: Contributed to the team developing Dinemetric, an AI-powered restaurant management platform. The product connects restaurant workflows with operational insights and menu recommendations.
dinemetric.outcome: The platform gives restaurant teams a single place to access operational insights and AI-powered menu recommendations.

smilysis.title: Smilysis
smilysis.description: An application for tracking dental habits and progress with AI-powered scans and personalized insights.
smilysis.problem: Bring dental habits, scan-based insights, and oral-health progress into one tracking experience.
smilysis.decision: Uses a shared Supabase client with session persistence so sign-in state can be reused across the application.
smilysis.details: Team contribution to a dental-health tracking application. The live link opens the public welcome screen introducing scans, food insights, and oral-health scores.
smilysis.contribution: Contributed to the team developing Smilysis, a dental-health tracking application. The product brings together daily habits, scan-based insights, and personalized progress tracking.
smilysis.outcome: The application brings dental habits, scan-based insights, and oral-health progress into one experience.

aboutTitle: An engineering foundation. Hands-on software experience.
aboutBio: I’m Samaneh Heshmatzadeh, a full-stack software developer based in Metro Vancouver. I bring an electrical engineering background and a Software Systems Developer certificate from BCIT to my work—combining analytical problem-solving with hands-on experience building and supporting web applications.

sparkbridge.description: Build and maintain customer-facing applications with React, Next.js, Django, and PostgreSQL. My work spans dashboards, onboarding flows, REST APIs, authentication, and AI integrations.

pdf.description: Developed Angular interfaces and .NET Core APIs for semiconductor manufacturing analytics. Connected AWS Keyspaces data to services and built D3.js visualizations for defect analysis.

pellonia.description: Developed reusable React components for a customer-facing anti-piracy dashboard, integrated REST APIs, and supported debugging, releases, and ongoing interface improvements.
